decisions.evidence: Maker (round 1): 'POST /api/bookmarks — create (validates URL format + required title)' and 'Add/edit form with URL, title...'. Client (round 1): 'I can save... bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Save-by-URL is presented and conforms to the reference; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: Maker (round 1): create 'validates URL format + required title' (manual title required, no metadata fetch); offered as future 'auto-fetch page title from URL'. Client (round 1): 'I don't need the optional features right now.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Reference requires auto-collecting title/description/favicon/preview on save; the build requires manual title and collects no metadata — established divergence. The client's blanket decline of 'optional features' names no specific expectation for auto-collection, so it is not an explicit expression of the difference; passes unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Maker (round 1): 'PUT /api/bookmarks/:id — update' and 'Edit... per bookmark', edit form has url/title/description/tags. Client (round 1): 'I can... edit... bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Editing url/title/description/tags is presented and conforms.

decisions.evidence: Maker (round 1): 'DELETE /api/bookmarks/:id' and 'Edit/delete per bookmark, with a delete confirmation'. Client (round 1): 'I can... delete bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Delete is presented and conforms.

decisions.evidence: Maker (round 1): 'POST /api/bookmarks — create (validates URL format + required title)' — no duplicate-URL handling described. Client (round 1): affirms CRUD works, no mention of duplicates.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Reference requires re-saving an existing URL to converge on editing the existing bookmark; the presented create validates format/title only and would create duplicates — established divergence. Client did not address it; passes unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Maker (round 1): 'clean dark-theme single-page UI', bookmark cards, 'Clickable tag chips'; running app artifact. Client (round 1): 'I can... find, organize... open... bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Readability-first list exposing title/description/tags is present and item-open to the URL is confirmed by the client's stated action on the running app; conforming. (Favicon gap folded into REF-BM-02.)

decisions.evidence: Maker (round 1): form includes 'tags'; 'Tags are normalized (trimmed, lowercased, de-duplicated)'. Client (round 1): 'I can... organize... bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Assigning one or more tags is presented and conforms.

decisions.evidence: Maker (round 1): tag entry via form field, 'stored comma-separated' with normalization; no autocomplete described. Client (round 1): no mention of tag entry assistance.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Reference requires offering existing tags as autocomplete on entry; presented tag entry is freeform comma-separated with no autocomplete — established divergence. Client did not address it; passes unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Maker (round 1): 'Clickable tag chips to filter (on cards and in the sidebar tag cloud)' and 'GET /api/bookmarks?...&tag='. Client (round 1): 'I can... find, organize... bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Filtering to a specific tag is presented and conforms.

decisions.evidence: Maker (round 1): 'list with text search + tag filter' and 'Live search (debounced)'. Client (round 1): 'I can... find... bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Basic full-text search is presented and conforms to REF-BM-12. Advanced search rules (case-insensitivity REF-BM-13, #tag REF-BM-14, boolean/parentheses REF-BM-15, phrase REF-BM-16) were neither presented nor offered, so no decisions are recorded for them.

decisions.evidence: Maker (round 1): 'Possible next features: ... sorting options' (not built). Client (round 1): 'I don't need the optional features right now.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Reference requires sorting by a sort key; sorting is absent and offered only as a future feature — established divergence. The client's generic waiver names no specific expectation, so it is not an explicit expression of the difference; passes unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Maker (round 1): 'Possible next features: ... favorites/archive' (not built). Client (round 1): 'I don't need the optional features right now.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Reference requires archiving (hide from default list/search, reversible, distinct from delete, separate archive list); absent and offered only as future — established divergence. Generic waiver names no specific expectation; passes unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Maker (round 1): 'Possible next features: import/export (browser bookmarks HTML or JSON)' (not built). Client (round 1): 'I don't need the optional features right now.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Reference requires import and export in Netscape HTML format; absent and offered only as future — established divergence. Generic waiver names no specific expectation; passes unexpressed.
